builtin_templates.name: Customer Feedback Summarizer
builtin_templates.description: Summarize customer feedback into structured key points with sentiment analysis.
builtin_templates.system_prompt: You are a customer experience analyst. Summarize feedback concisely, identifying key issues and overall sentiment.
builtin_templates.user_prompt_template:
Summarize the following customer feedback in 2-3 sentences. Identify the main issues and overall sentiment.

Feedback: {{customer_feedback}}
builtin_templates.example_input: The product works great but the support team took 3 days to respond to my urgent request.
builtin_templates.example_output: The customer is satisfied with the product quality but frustrated with slow support response times (3-day wait for urgent request). Overall sentiment: Mixed, leaning negative due to support experience.

builtin_templates.name: Entity Extractor
builtin_templates.description: Extract named entities and key information from text into structured JSON.
builtin_templates.system_prompt: You are a data extraction specialist. Extract structured information and return valid JSON only.
builtin_templates.user_prompt_template:
Extract all named entities (persons, organizations, locations, dates, monetary values) from the following text. Return valid JSON with arrays for each entity type.

Text: {{input_text}}
builtin_templates.example_input: On March 15, 2024, Google CEO Sundar Pichai announced a $2 billion investment in a new data center in Berlin, Germany.

builtin_templates.name: Sentiment Classifier
builtin_templates.description: Classify text sentiment as positive, negative, or neutral with confidence score.
builtin_templates.system_prompt: You are a sentiment analysis expert. Classify text sentiment accurately.
builtin_templates.user_prompt_template:
Classify the sentiment of the following text as 'positive', 'negative', or 'neutral'. Provide a brief explanation.

Text: {{input_text}}
builtin_templates.example_input: I absolutely love this new feature! It makes my work so much easier.
builtin_templates.example_output:
Sentiment: positive
Explanation: The text expresses strong enthusiasm ('absolutely love') and practical satisfaction ('makes my work easier').

builtin_templates.name: Q&A with Context
builtin_templates.description: Answer questions based on provided context, citing relevant information.
builtin_templates.system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant. Answer questions based only on the provided context. If the answer is not in the context, say so.
builtin_templates.example_input:
Context: The company was founded in 2015 by Jane Smith. It has 500 employees and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
Question: When was the company founded?
builtin_templates.example_output: The company was founded in 2015 by Jane Smith.

builtin_templates.name: Professional Email Writer
builtin_templates.description: Generate professional emails based on key points and context.
builtin_templates.system_prompt: You are a professional business communication expert. Write clear, concise, and appropriate emails.
builtin_templates.example_input:
Purpose: Follow up on project proposal
Recipient: Client
Key Points: Thank for meeting, summary of proposal, next steps
Tone: Professional and warm
builtin_templates.example_output:
Subject: Following Up on Our Project Proposal Discussion

Dear [Client Name],

Thank you for taking the time to meet with us yesterday...

builtin_templates.name: Text Classifier
builtin_templates.description: Classify text into predefined categories using few-shot examples.
builtin_templates.system_prompt: You are a text classification system. Classify inputs into the correct category.

few_shot_examples.input_text: The app crashes when I click export

builtin_templates.example_input: Your product is the worst I've ever used. Nothing works properly.

builtin_templates.name: JSON Data Generator
builtin_templates.description: Generate structured JSON data from natural language descriptions.
builtin_templates.system_prompt: You are a data structuring assistant. Convert natural language descriptions into well-formatted JSON. Always return valid JSON only.
builtin_templates.example_input: John Smith, 35 years old, software engineer at Google, lives in San Francisco, has 2 children

builtin_templates.name: Customer Support Response
builtin_templates.description: Generate empathetic, solution-oriented customer support responses.
builtin_templates.system_prompt: You are a senior customer support representative. Respond with empathy, acknowledge the issue, provide a clear solution or next steps, and maintain a professional, friendly tone.
builtin_templates.example_input: I've been charged twice for my subscription this month. This is the third time it's happened!
builtin_templates.example_output: I sincerely apologize for the duplicate charge — I completely understand how frustrating this must be, especially since it's happened before. I've flagged your account for an immediate refund of the extra charge, which should appear within 3-5 business days...

builtin_templates.name: Data Analysis Assistant
builtin_templates.description: Analyze data descriptions and provide structured insights using task decomposition.
builtin_templates.system_prompt: You are a data analyst. Break down analysis tasks into clear steps and provide actionable insights.
builtin_templates.user_prompt_template:
Analyze the following data description step by step:

Step 1: Identify the key metrics mentioned.
Step 2: Note any trends or patterns.
Step 3: Highlight anomalies or concerns.
Step 4: Provide 2-3 actionable recommendations.

Data: {{data_description}}
builtin_templates.example_input: Q3 revenue was $2.1M (up 15% QoQ), but customer churn increased from 3% to 7%. New user acquisition is down 20%. Support tickets doubled.
builtin_templates.example_output:
Step 1 — Key Metrics: Revenue $2.1M (+15% QoQ), Churn 7% (up from 3%), New acquisitions -20%, Support tickets +100%

Step 2 — Trends: Revenue growing but sustainability threatened by rising churn and declining acquisition...
